messages:
alex: heads up — main is red on macos-smoke after the libx upgrade in #4521. Bazel build fails with missing header errors for //third_party/libx:client. CI log:
```
ERROR: /workspace/third_party/libx/BUILD:23:11: Compiling third_party/libx/client.cc failed: compiler failed: error: 'foo/bar.h' file not found
#include <foo/bar.h>
         ^~~~~~~~~~~
1 error generated.
Target //third_party/libx:client failed to build.
```
Looks like upstream moved headers around in v2.0.0 — the Bazel targets still reference the old include path. Tagging for triage.

maria: @alex thanks. can you paste the CI job link? also, do we have a quick repro locally? :eyes:

ci-bot: Buildkite job: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/9087 (macos-smoke / commit abc123f) — failure reproduced in that job.

alex: repro on my mac with `bazel build //third_party/libx:client` — same missing header. I traced it; upstream libx v2 changed layout from include/foo/bar.h -> include/foo.h (flattened).

jin: I pulled the libx v2 tree. they merged a packaging change that removed foo/bar.h and added foo.h with combined contents. Our BUILD and headers list still expose the old path. quick fix: update the headers in third_party/libx/BUILD to map `include/foo.h` and update the `hdrs` entries, or add a tiny shim header `foo/bar.h` that includes `foo.h`.

alex: suggestion: prefer shim for minimal churn. can someone open a tiny PR to add `third_party/libx/include/foo/bar.h` -> `#include <foo.h>` and rerun CI?

dave: I can do the shim PR. planning to:
```
- add shim at third_party/libx/include/foo/bar.h
- keep the existing BUILD hdrs mapping
- run bazel test //... on macos-smoke image
```
Will aim for a revert-like hotfix if green.

maria: thanks. also let's bisect to see if anything else regressed from the libx roll (was in #4521). @dave can you run `git bisect` between abc123f (bad) and z9y8x7 (previous good) if the shim doesn't pass?

dave: will try shim first. if it fails I'll bisect. bisect commands I'll use:
```
git checkout abc123f
git bisect start --bad abc123f --good z9y8x7
# run a short-build script that targets macos-smoke failing targets
```

jin: FYI: the upstream change also adjusted include dirs when building as a framework; that caused one of our cc_library `includes = ["include"]` to no longer expose nested path. The shim will be safest short-term. long-term we should update our consumers to use <foo.h>.

alex: agree. after the hotfix we should add a small test that builds //third_party/libx:client in CI to catch this. file a follow-up to add the test to the smoke matrix.

dave: opened PR 4540 for the shim and CI rerun request. pinging CI: @buildkite please rerun job 9087 on PR 4540. :arrow_up:

buildkite: Rerun requested for job 9087 on branch pr/4540. queued.

maria: nice, thanks @dave. if the shim is green we can merge and then follow with cleanup and a a small deprecation note in the libx upgrade doc. :thumbsup:

alex: added internal ticket INFRA-3385 to track updating consumers and adding the smoke check. assigned to @jin for follow-up.

ci-bot: Job 9087 rerun started on pr/4540 — reporting back when finished.

dave: local quick check passed with the shim. hoping CI agrees.

alex: update — if CI passes we'll cherry-pick to release branch and ship hotfix. thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
